indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX standings_official_reviews_batch_idx ON public.standings_official_reviews USING btree (batch_id, reviewed_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX standings_official_reviews_pkey ON public.standings_official_reviews USING btree (id)

triggers.name: standings_activation_complete
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER standings_activation_complete BEFORE INSERT ON public.standings_official_reviews FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION check_standings_activation()

constraints.name: standings_official_reviews_batch_id_batch_payload_hash_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (batch_id, batch_payload_hash) REFERENCES standings_batches(id, payload_hash)

constraints.name: standings_official_reviews_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(((payload -> 'evidence'::text) -> 'tables'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length(((payload -> 'evidence'::text) -> 'tables'::text)) > 0) AND (((payload -> 'evidence'::text) ->> 'batch_id'::text) = (batch_id)::text) AND (((payload -> 'evidence'::text) ->> 'payload_hash'::text) = batch_payload_hash) AND (jsonb_typeof((payload -> 'differences'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((payload -> 'reasons'::text)) = 'array'::text)) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: standings_official_reviews_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((NOT activated) OR (((payload ->> 'activation_requested'::text) = 'true'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length((payload -> 'differences'::text)) = 0) AND (jsonb_array_length((payload -> 'reasons'::text)) = 0))) IS TRUE))
